snippet.title: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the official gameplay trailer for Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979, an atmospheric post-apocalyptic survival horror game developed by Rodrigo Banzato.

Set in a brutal nuclear wasteland, the game blends third-person with intense first-person action, tactical V8 driving mechanics, and tense psychological suspense inspired by classic survival horror.

🎮 Wishlist Just Madness on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652470/Just_Madness_Earth_Apocalypse_1979/

📖 Read the official companion novel on Amazon Kindle Unlimited: 
https://amazon.com/dp/B0HCVY66WS

🌐 Official Website & Press Kit: https://www.rodrigobanzato.com
Business Inquiries: info@rodrigobanzato.com

Produced by Rodrigo Banzato Cia Ltda. All rights reserved.
